message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount |
|----------|------------|----------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1–1½ lb (450–680 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 cloves |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1–2 Tbsp |
| | Salt | 1 tsp |
| | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | ¼ tsp |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | 1 Tbsp chopped |
| | Red wine (optional) | ½ cup |
| | Beef broth or water | ½ cup |
| | Sugar (to balance acidity) | 1 tsp |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| **Mozzarella Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups |
| **Optional Extras** | Spinach (fresh or frozen, wilted) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | Carrot, grated | ½ cup |
| | Zucchini, grated | ½ cup |
| | Ricotta or cottage cheese (for extra creaminess) | ½ cup |

### Quick Tips
- **No‑boil sheets** save time; just add a little extra liquid to the sauce.
- **Season the meat sauce** early—sauté onions and garlic before adding tomatoes.
- **Layer wisely**: start with a thin sauce layer, then pasta, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and repeat.
- **Bake at 375 °F (190 °C)** for 25–35 min, then let rest 10 min before serving.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
